scientific_integrity: The asymptotic conclusion rests on a complete orbit-counting and union-bound proof; independent examination has not been performed. Previously known qualitative asymmetry and Burnside class counts are credited.
scientific_limitations: The result gives asymptotic rather than exact arbitrary-order counts for nonrigid labeled operations; finite exhaustive operation-table enumeration covers only orders three and four. A closely related 2023 paper on random finite groupoids was accessible only in abstract. Literature completeness is not established.
title: Sharp rare-symmetry law for commutative idempotent magmas
